name: VRM_PRICING_LINES
description: This is an extension object to document lines  that store the processing results of Dimension Value Assignment Process i.e. Pricing_Combination_Id and Line Grouping i.e. Line_Group_Number.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_LINE_ID
columns.description: Internal unique identifier of a source document line.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a source document.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Price basis line status. Values derived from the lookup type VSOE_PBL_STATUS.

columns.name: GROUP_NUMBER
columns.description: Internal unique identifier of a line group.

columns.name: GROUPING_REASON_CODE
columns.description: Reason code for a line grouping.

columns.name: PRICING_COMBINATION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the pricing dimension combination.

columns.name: ITEM_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of an item group.

columns.name: TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: Internal Identifier of the FMV template.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_DATE
columns.description: Date of source document.

columns.name: DIMENSION_FLAG
columns.description: Flag that indicates whether pricing combination is successfully derived for the given document line.

columns.name: MEA_FLAG
columns.description: A flag to indicates whether the source document line belong to a MEA or not.

columns.name: EXCLUDED_FLAG
columns.description: Flag that indicates if standalone sales has been excluded from VSOE price calculation.

columns.name: EXCLUSION_REASON_CODE
columns.description: Exclusion reason to exclude a line from VSOE price calculation. Values are from the lookup VSOE_PBL_EXCLUDING_REASON.

columns.name: EXCLUSION_REVIEW_FLAG
columns.description: Flag that indicates if a revenue analyst or manager has reviewed the line marked as excluded by the system.

columns.name: EXCEPTION_FLAG
columns.description: Flag that indicates if VSOE price has an exception.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REVENUE_DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a revenue document.

columns.name: REV_PROGRAM_CONTROL_ID
columns.description: Internal Identifier of the revenue program run.

columns.name: WORKER_NUMBER
columns.description: Number of parallel processes for a concurrent process.

columns.name: PREV_DOCUMENT_LINE_ID
columns.description: Reference document line internal identifier.

columns.name: NET_LINE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Line amount after adjusting return amount.

columns.name: NET_UNIT_SALES_PRICE
columns.description: Unit selling price after adjusting return amount.

columns.name: NET_UNIT_SALES_PCT_BASE_PRICE
columns.description: Unit sales percent base price after adjusting return amount.

columns.name: NET_DISCOUNT_PERCENT
columns.description: Discount percentage after adjusting return amount.

columns.name: REVISED_COST
columns.description: Adjusted cost of sale after the document is revised.

columns.name: REVISED_GROSS_MARGIN_PERCENT
columns.description: Adjusted gross margin of sales after the document is revised.

columns.name: CONCATENATED_SEGMENTS
columns.description: The concatenated pricing dimension flexfield.

columns.name: DISPLAY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether to display the FMV for the line. Possible values are Yes or No.

columns.name: ITEM_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates the type of a source document items. Possible values are ITEM, MEMO_LINE and ITEM_GROUP.

columns.name: ITEM_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Item type unique identifier.

columns.name: NET_QUANTITY
columns.description: Net quantity of a transaction line.

columns.name: UPDATE_FMV_REP_VALUE
columns.description: Indicates whether to allow updates on Base Price Percentage or Cost or not. Possible values are Yes or No.

columns.name: COMMENTS
columns.description: Comments entered for MEA or standalone sales.

columns.name: REVISED_UOM_CODE
columns.description: Revised unit of measure code.

columns.name: NET_DISCOUNT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Net discount amount of the original line.

columns.name: REV_REC_STATUS
columns.description: Status of a document line to indicate whether line is processed by revenue.

columns.name: ELEMENT_TYPE
columns.description: Element is a deliverable or separate unit of accounting. Used to group element types for FMV sets. Values are from the lookup VRM_ELEMENT_TYPE.

columns.name: NET_UNIT_LIST_PRICE
columns.description: Net unit list price discount used to validate VSOE value of a MEA line.

columns.name: NET_BASE_PRICE
columns.description: Net base price used to validate VSOE value of a MEA line.

columns.name: DELIVERED_DATE
columns.description: Fulfillment date of a source document line.

columns.name: RECONCILIATION_STATUS
columns.description: The billing and revenue reconciliation status for a revenue line.

columns.name: RECONCILIATION_DATE
columns.description: Date the revenue line is reconciled.

columns.name: BILLED_AMOUNT
columns.description: Line amount of the transaction line. Tax amount is excluded.

columns.name: DELIVERY_DATE
columns.description: Fulfillment date of a source document line.

columns.name: DELIVERY_STATUS
columns.description: Delivery status of a source document. Values are from the lookup VRM_MEA_LINE_DELIVERY_STATUS.

columns.name: RECONCILIATION_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Request with the updated reconciliation information on the pricing line.

columns.name: RECONCILIATION_BATCH_NUMBER
columns.description: Identifies the batch to be processed for a reconciliation request.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Ledger unique identifier.

columns.name: CUST_CONTRACT_CREATION_STATUS
columns.description: Status used to track whether this line is included in a performance obligation line of a contract.

columns.name: CUST_CONTRACT_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created a customer contract using this row.

columns.name: SATISFACTION_MEASUREMENT_MODEL
columns.description: Specifies how satisfaction will be measured and recorded for a performance obligation line. Values are from the lookup type ORA_VRM_SATIS_MEAS_MODEL.

columns.name: REVENUE_RULE_ID
columns.description: Revenue scheduling rule unique identifier.

columns.name: REVENUE_RULE_DURATION
columns.description: Number of periods in which revenue of this  performance obligation line is to be recognized.

columns.name: CONTRACT_UPDATE_TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: Revenue contract update template identifier.

columns.name: INITIAL_DOCUMENT_LINE_ID
columns.description: Reference key that identifies the parent source document line for the current line.

columns.name: ADD_TO_CONTRACT_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Specifies how a new line from the source system should be processed. Values are derived from the lookup type ORA_ADD_TO_CONTRACT_ACTION. Blank is equivalent to ORA_ADD_TO_EXISTING_PO.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_LINE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Specifies the type of line sent from the source system. Values are derived from the lookup type ORA_VRM_DOCUMENT_LINE_TYPE. Blank is equivalent to ORA_NEW_LINE.

columns.name: TOP_PARENT_DOCUMENT_LINE_ID
columns.description: Reference key that identifies the top most parent document line for the current line.

columns.name: REVISION_INTENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Revision intent for the source document revision line. Values are from the lookup type ORA_VRM_REVISION_INTENT_TYPE.

columns.name: WARNING_MESSAGE_NAME
columns.description: Specifies message name for warning line.

columns.name: CONTRACT_RULE_ID
columns.description: Internal identifier of the customer contract identification rule.

columns.name: CONTRACT_HASH_CODE
columns.description: Contract processing unique identifier.

columns.name: CONTRACT_REFERENCE
columns.description: User entered contract reference or grouping attribute values used to identify the contract as derived by enabling the Copy to Reference option in the Contract Identification rule.

columns.name: CONTRACT_TYPE
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: CONTRACT_CLASSIFICATION_CODE
columns.description: Classification code of a contract. Values are derived from lookup type ORA_VRM_CONTRACT_CLASSIF_CODE.

columns.name: IMMATERIAL_CHANGE_CODE
columns.description: Immaterial change type for this line. Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_IMMATERIAL_CHANGE_TYPE.

columns.name: CONTRACT_MODIFICATION_DATE
columns.description: The date on which the revenue contract was modified.

columns.name: LATEST_IMMATERIAL_CHANGE_CODE
columns.description: Latest immaterial change type for this line. Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_IMMATERIAL_CHANGE_TYPE.

columns.name: LATEST_CONTRACT_MOD_DATE
columns.description: Latest date on which the revenue contract was modified.

columns.name: REVISED_RECURRING_FLAG
columns.description: Revised indicator specifying that the line will recur on the line's satisfaction plan end date. Valid values are from the lookup type VRM_YES/NO.

columns.name: REVISED_RECURRING_FREQUENCY
columns.description: Revised frequency number of the recurring pattern.

columns.name: REVISED_RECUR_PATTERN_CODE
columns.description: Revised recurring frequency of the line. Valid values are from the lookup type VRM_RECUR_PATTERN_CODE.

columns.name: REVISED_TERMINATION_DATE
columns.description: Revised termination date, which is the date the line was terminated and will no longer recur automatically.

columns.name: REVISED_RECURRING_AMOUNT
columns.description: Revised selling amount per frequency for the recurring line.

columns.name: REVISED_RULE_END_DATE
columns.description: Revised revenue recoginition end date for the revenue scheduling rule.

columns.name: REVISED_RULE_START_DATE
columns.description: Revised revenue recoginition start date for the revenue scheduling rule.

columns.name: REVISED_ACCOUNTING_RULE_ID
columns.description: Revised revenue scheduling rule identifier.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Source document group identifier used to group the initial recurring source document header and system-generated recurring source document headers. Value is the source document identifier for the original source document.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_DOCUMENT_LINE_ID
columns.description: Original source document line identifier used to create the recurring source document line.

columns.name: RECUR_LINE_PROCESSED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates the line was processed for the period. Valid values are from the lookup type VRM_YES/NO.

columns.name: TERMINATION_DATE
columns.description: The date on which the revenue line was terminated.

columns.name: NET_UNIT_SSP
columns.description: Net unit standalone selling price of the item or memo line.

columns.name: LATEST_PERIOD_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Latest satisfaction period action that was processed on this document line. Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_VRM_PERIOD_SUBLINE_ACTION.

columns.name: TOTAL_REVERSAL_DAYS
columns.description: Total number of days the service was suspended. This value is calculated based on the number of days between the effective dates of all reversals and their corresponding reinstatements.

columns.name: LATEST_REVERSAL_DAYS
columns.description: Number of days since the latest suspension of service. This value is calculated based on the the number of days between the effective plan end date of the promised detail and the recently processed reversal subline.

columns.name: REVISED_SERVICE_UOM
columns.description: Revised unit of measure of the service item on the source document line. Valid values are from the Price Periodicity UOM Class defined in Oracle Fusion Pricing.

columns.name: REVISED_SERVICE_DURATION
columns.description: Revised duration of the service item in terms of the service unit of measure.
